notes.title: Volume controls and more
notes.content:
There's an update to the demo that includes
- Volume controls (finally!) 
- Modified the camera angles to be slightly more top-down allowing for easier judgement of shot angles
- Added an optional Easy mode that reduces the pressure buildup and gives two extra lives. You'll see this if you fail a level twice consecutively. It can easily be turned on and off from the settings.
- Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Bat to the Beat - Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Release!
[/h1]
A demo is now out on Steam. Please try it out and follow and wishlist the game!

[h3]What is Bat to the Beat?
[/h3]Swing your bat to the beat in this cricket-themed rhythm action game. Travel the world, mastering the unique rhythms of each location with easy-to-learn two button controls. Score as many runs as you can, batting to the beat and switching between attack and defense.

[h3]What’s included in the demo?
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Four levels and an interactive tutorial to introduce the basic mechanics
[*] A campaign mode that takes you to England, Jamaica, India and Australia
[*] A "timeless test" score attack mode with global leaderboards for each level
[/list]

[h3]What are your future plans for the game?
[/h3]We're working on additional levels and features for the full game, and in the meantime hope to gather constructive feedback and suggestions from players who try out the demo.

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/VA76TuZqcV]Discord[/url] and follow the game on [url=https://x.com/battothebeat]Twitter[/url]
